episode_title: What If AI Could Clone You at Work?

real_qa.q: How does TwinOneAI create digital twins that preserve privacy and governance boundaries while scaling knowledge across organizations?
real_qa.r: TwinOneAI creates digital twins in two core pieces: first, a model of your knowledge, judgment, decision-making, and real-time working context; second, trust and governance around you that maps every relationship and distills that judgment into the AI. The company employs seven layers of interlocking rules-based and AI-based privacy filters covering PII, health information, GDPR compliance, and relationship-specific sharing calibrated on previous interactions, plus hard deterministic rails that AI cannot circumvent.

real_qa.q: What is the inspiration behind TwinOneAI and how did Louis Liu transition from Eigen Technologies to founding the company?
real_qa.r: The inspiration came from unfinished business at Eigen—the realization that while AI was solving 5% of the problem by digitizing contracts, people really needed to know the negotiation pathway and conditions that led to outcomes. Liu also drew inspiration from a Star Trek Next Generation episode where a digital twin of an engineer helped solve a crisis. After selling Eigen about two years before founding TwinOneAI, Liu used his experience as a second-time founder to quickly build a prototype, recruit trusted collaborators, and validate the thesis with early customers.
real_qa.requete: Louis Liu Eigen Technologies TwinOneAI founding story

real_qa.q: How quickly can credit unions deploy TwinOneAI and what is the setup process?
real_qa.r: Setup is designed for lean IT teams at credit unions: it takes less than 10 minutes with approximately 17 clicks for an admin to set up a twin for the organization. After setup, the twin takes 24 hours to gestate and create itself before it is ready to use.
real_qa.requete: TwinOneAI credit union deployment time setup process

real_qa.q: How does TwinOneAI solve the problem of agentic drift and AI alignment in enterprise adoption?
real_qa.r: TwinOneAI addresses agentic drift through its MCP server architecture: when an AI agent interacts with a digital twin, the same privacy and trust boundary conditions apply as with human interactions. The digital twin acts as a manifestation of the human in the agentic realm, coaching other agents while respecting the human's preferences, eliminating the need for constant human supervision of long-horizon agents.
real_qa.requete: TwinOneAI agentic drift AI alignment MCP server

real_qa.q: Which credit unions are already using TwinOneAI and what challenges do credit unions face in AI adoption?
real_qa.r: Shoreline Credit Union in Wisconsin is one of TwinOneAI's first credit union customers. Credit unions typically lack massive IT teams compared to large banks, operate with lean compliance and legal staff (often just one officer per function), and face pressure during staff absences. TwinOneAI's product is designed to make deployment easy for organizations with limited technical sophistication or IT resources.

guest.bio_context: Louis Liu is a second-time founder with deep expertise in AI for financial services. He previously founded Eigen Technologies, one of the first AI companies in enterprise and fintech that digitized over 100 trillion dollars worth of financial contracts and served half the world's largest banks. Eigen became the first AI company to receive regulatory approval from the Federal Reserve and FDIC to process financial contracts for banks. Liu holds a PhD in Physics and a double major in Fine Arts.
